allow: PowerShell(Copy-Item -Path "frontend" -Destination "legacy-frontend" -Recurse -Exclude @\("node_modules","dist"\) -Force; Get-ChildItem legacy-frontend -Name; "--- src ---"; Get-ChildItem legacy-frontend\\src -Recurse -Name)

PowerShell(Remove-Item -Recurse -Force legacy-frontend\\node_modules -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force legacy-frontend\\dist -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem legacy-frontend -Name; "--- size ---"; "{0:N1} MB" -f \(\(Get-ChildItem legacy-frontend -Recurse -File | Measure-Object Length -Sum\).Sum / 1MB\))

PowerShell(cd frontend; $p = Get-Content node_modules\\motion\\package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; "version: $\($p.version\)"; "peer: $\($p.peerDependencies | ConvertTo-Json -Compress\)"; "--- react export ---"; $p.exports.'./react' | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; "--- framer-motion present: ---"; Test-Path node_modules\\framer-motion)
